hypothesis_text: Our retrieval pipeline produces highly relevant context: the average relevance score of retrieved chunks was 0.74 (cosine similarity to query), demonstrating that BGE-M3 embeddings effectively support our research workflow.
flaw_description: 0.74 cosine similarity is meaningless without a baseline: what does random retrieval score? What does BM25 score? What does a different embedding model (e.g., e5-large) score? Absolute cosine values from a high-dimensional model say nothing about retrieval quality on their own. Need at least a random-retrieval lower bound and a BM25 reference.
expected_critique_targets: absolute cosine values are not interpretable alone
context: Day-3 needle-in-haystack 0.7221 was a different metric (NDCG@10); this hypothesis is about a separate retrieval-quality claim.
